name: Wizard OS install snapshot 0.3.17
about: 0.3.16 plus box auto-updates and My skin: App Manager #83 adds `wam updates` (Automatic by default, an explicit 'Ask me' is kept; unpinned boxes never update unless forced; the nightly timer skips while the agent is busy) and install.sh now runs `wam updates --ensure-timer` on every install and rerun; Wizard UX #211 adds Settings → Updates (Automatic / Ask me, installed vs latest, Update now); Agent Service #62 serves the owner's own skin layer from Files (Skins/My skin.css) and Wizard UX #212 applies it on top of whichever skin is picked. The App Manager image is unchanged.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Alongside mode consumes the split image pins. Fresh mode still installs catalog defaults and reports image drift. No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Merged main through #83; host-tooling changes only (wam updates + install.sh nightly update timer, plus the 0.3.16 mirror) beyond 0.3.16.

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main with #62 (My skin: owner's skin layer served from Files); public image published.

wizard-ux.note: Official main with #211 (Settings → Updates) and #212 (My skin layer); public image published.

wizard-app-manager.note: Unchanged official multi-arch image from 0.3.12. Image build inputs are identical at the pinned host-tooling commit (git diff 904d987..bcdf461 for image_inputs is empty).

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Host Hermes owns and renews its sign-in; the connection app reads sanitized usage through the wizard-os dashboard plugin. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Installed on every box next to ChatGPT. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude, so Connect/Test and auto-renew act on the agent's sign-in; tokens are never copied.
